from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
r=Path(sys.argv[1]); ref=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'WORKTREE'
def g(*a): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],cwd=r)
def h(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def read(p): return (r/p).read_bytes() if ref=='WORKTREE' else g('show',ref+':'+p)
d=json.loads(read('reports/cc16_native_text_shader_raw_storage.json'))
b={x['path']:g('show',d['base']+':'+x['path']) for x in d['four_Source_files']}
a={p:read(p) for p in b}; c=dict(b)
for x in d['four_Source_files']:
 p=x['path']; assert h(b[p])==x['before']['sha256'] and h(a[p])==x['after']['sha256']
 for key,v in [('frozen_before_path',b[p]),('frozen_after_path',a[p])]:
  f=Path(x[key]); assert f.read_bytes()==v
for s in d['thirteen_exact_seams']:
 p=s['path']; old=base64.b64decode(s['before']); new=base64.b64decode(s['after']); o=s['offset']
 assert h(c[p])==s['full_file_before_sha256'] and c[p][o:o+len(old)]==old
 assert h(old)==s['before_sha256'] and h(new)==s['after_sha256']
 c[p]=c[p][:o]+new+c[p][o+len(old):]
 assert h(c[p])==s['full_file_after_sha256']
 assert Path(s['frozen_intermediate_path']).read_bytes()==c[p]
assert c==a
for s in reversed(d['thirteen_exact_seams']):
 p=s['path']; old=base64.b64decode(s['before']); new=base64.b64decode(s['after']); o=s['offset']
 assert h(c[p])==s['full_file_after_sha256'] and c[p][o:o+len(new)]==new
 c[p]=c[p][:o]+old+c[p][o+len(new):]
 assert h(c[p])==s['full_file_before_sha256']
assert c==b
print(json.dumps({'ref':ref,'full_forward_reverse_files':len(b),'seams':len(d['thirteen_exact_seams']),'all_intermediates_Git_raw_frozen_equal':True}))
